content: Swarmpit: SWARMPIT_INFLUXDB unset => statistics disabled. Autoredeploy is implemented in the app (src/clj/swarmpit/agent.clj, chime 1-minute periodic job comparing registry digest, api/redeploy-service); no dependency on the swarmpit/agent container or InfluxDB. Agent container supplies events, stats and logs (logs fall back to service logs API).
